record.statement: For Gaussian fields on D_N whose covariance scales to the continuum Green function and has a shift-invariant local limit, prove the analogues of Theorem 2.7 (intermediate level sets) and Theorem 9.3 (full extremal process).
record.status_search: Documented bounded search 2026-09-07: Ding-Roy-Zeitouni (Ann. Probab. 2017) proved convergence in law of the centred maximum for log-correlated Gaussian fields with the required covariance structure; whether the full extremal process (Theorem 9.3 analogue) and the level-set limit (Theorem 2.7 analogue) have been proved in the generality of Problem 16.8 was not established in the search, so the problem is kept with the maximum part noted as resolved.
record.title: Universality of level sets and extremal process for log-correlated Gaussian fields in d=2

record.statement: For percolation on the torus of side n in dimension d > 6, show that the maximiser p_c^{(1)} of the derivative of log of the torus susceptibility satisfies |p_c^{(1)} - p_c(T_{n,d})| = O(V^{-1/3}), and similarly for the other two candidate definitions p_c^{(2)}, p_c^{(3)}.
record.title: Notions of criticality for percolation on high-dimensional tori

record.statement: For critical percolation on Z^d, d > 6, show that the empirical measure of the cluster of the origin, rescaled by n^{-1/4} in space, conditioned on |C(0)| = n, converges in distribution to integrated super-Brownian excursion (ISE).
record.status_search: Hara and Slade proved convergence of the r-point functions of the critical cluster to those of ISE for spread-out models in d > 6 (2000); convergence of the conditional measure itself and the nearest-neighbour case were not verified as resolved.
record.title: ISE scaling limit of critical high-dimensional percolation clusters of fixed size

record.statement: For i.i.d. initial heights s(x) in {0,1,2,3,4} on Z^2 (with a given law), the event that every site topples infinitely often has probability 0 or 1; give an algorithm deciding which, as a function of the law.
record.title: Decidability of infinite toppling for i.i.d. sandpiles on Z^2

record.statement: Is there a monotone coupling (omega_p)_{p in [0,1]} of the FK(p,q) measures for q in [0,1)? (Related to negative association for q < 1, C0091.)
record.title: Monotone coupling of random-cluster measures in p for cluster weight q < 1
